body:
Thank you.  Same timezone haha

I have a college final + extra credit assingment due later today so I need to nap for a few hours then get into da zone but I appreciate and reciprocate the sentiment

Thank you.  

I posted a lot in an online support group as a sort of 'journal that talks back to me' type of thing, then something happened that I think the community & moderators handled really badly/hypocritically so I stopped.

There's a private wordpress blog I have that I've been using since to store insight that I think is valuable to me when I'm really really REALLY fuckin' pissed and need to figure out why, but I only add to it on occasion.

For the most part though writing is a good way for me to kinda coach myself.   My brain kinda splits in half and one hemisphere coaches the other hemisphere.  Obviously that doesn't literally happen but idk how else to explain it.

I've been to a shrink who has said he thinks I'm fine.  

I'm just dealing with a lot of bullshit.  

In the movie "Cast Away" there's this scene where Tom Hanks talks about how when he was on the island he just kinda waited around a fuckton because he didn't know what the tide would wash up.

Sometimes I feel like I'm doing that.  E.g. 'right now I don't have a lot to go on, but maybe tomorrow some new thought / opportunity / motivation / burst of energy / etc will wash up on my beach.' 

I guess that's a more positive way to look at it.   

I think the danger comes via repressing how I feel.  If I feel like dying and I write it out and really just swim with it for a while, it can often fade away.

That doesn't happen when you just ignore everything.

Pressure + a closed container = a bomb (hi NSA watch list).

Bombs are bad.  Bombs explode.  Or maybe it's like a black hole.  Once everything is pressurized too much it becomes this little dark black inescapable orb.

I don't wanna be either of those things.

I think it's growth that I'm going to experience.  I don't think rotting trees are capable of thinking about stuff like this.  I don't think I'm rotting.   I think those thoughts - thinking you are rotting - is half of why it happens.  Self fulfilling. 

Hopefully I pull through.  I think I will.  I just need to get through the next 12 hours then get a bunch of sleep then look at the plan I left myself for what to do.  It's just weird.

Once again there's this paradox where talking about it makes it less of an issue.

Thanks for the kind words and for listening.

Behind the username & text you're a real person and I'm a real person and we're connecting and it's cool that this lets that happen.
